notes: Protocol for the PAPER system (no orders). Fixed before any prospective record is scored; changing any value means a new version, a new config_sha and a new evaluation window. The preregistered shadow control SHADOW_PURE_PREREG_V1 is not configured here.

execution.fee_model: kalshi_quadratic_taker: ev uses the continuous multiplier*P*(1-P); settled P&L uses the whole-order cent-rounded fee

uncertainty.note: p_model_sd = (P at mean*(1+s) - P at mean*(1-s)) / (2*1.2816), reading +-s as an ~80% band (s = 10% for player stats, 3% of team points for game markets), scaled by p_play, combined in quadrature with the participation term p_play*(1-p_play)*(p_cond - m_side) for DNP-exposed props

game_model.rho_source: estimated 2026-10-19 from data/history/espn/team_games_2025-26.parquet: correlation of the two teams' points residuals (points minus the team's own prior-games mean, min 10 games) within a game; raw 0.225 on 1,227 games, rounded down to 0.20. Not a fitted parameter of the pf-nba team model; treat game-market probabilities as approximate
game_model.tie_rule: half to each team (NBA games cannot end level; ties of the discretised pmf are split)

PF_ALL_CANDIDATES_V1.rule: every eligible contract, both sides, hypothetical P&L; no selection; rows are NOT independent observations

PF_EDGE_V1.protocol: Primary unit = game; primary horizon T-60; after >=200 independent decisions across >=40 games report ROI after fees with a game-clustered bootstrap CI; verdict language limited by docs/research/PAPER_ENGINE_SPEC.md section 8

PF_EDGE_STRICT_V1.protocol: as PF_EDGE_V1; the stricter filters were fixed in advance, not tuned

MARKET_ONLY_V1.rule: probability = quote mid; never trades; evaluated from the candidates' p_market

exposure.scope: applied independently inside each (strategy, horizon, decision instant): every horizon is an alternative simulated run of the strategy, never a stack of positions

thesis.game_margin: winner and spread contracts of both teams express one margin thesis: game|game|-|margin

hypotheses.statement: Buying NO on low-threshold ladder rungs (model P(X>=k|plays) below the market-implied probability) earns positive net P&L after fees
Buying UNDER on the game total when the modelled team points sum is below the market-implied total earns positive net P&L after fees
For the same player-game, the expression (points rung vs PRA rung) with the higher net EV has higher realised net P&L than the lower-EV expression
Participation-aware EV (DNP leg valued at the pre-game fair price) predicts realised P&L better than conditional-only EV

control.note: read from nba-shadow-pure value scorecards; never re-run or modified here
